title: σ-finiteness of μ⌞M for a positive locally integrable multiplicity (parent step 2)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^N, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, M ⊆ U, and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ(x) > 0 for every x ∈ M and θ μ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U. Then the restriction μ⌞M (Mathlib μ.restrict M, so (μ⌞M)(B) = μ(B ∩ M) for Borel B; M need not be measurable) is σ-finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μ) → SigmaFinite (μ.restrict M)
